# Heads or Tails — Online 3D Coin Toss & Flip Game (Raxzen)

> Official Website: https://toss-heads-or-tails.raxzen.in/
> Creator: Raxzen | Location: India | Last update: This month

## Summary
Heads or Tails by Raxzen is a fast, free, zero-download 3D online coin toss and coin flip web application. It is built for instant 50/50 random decision-making across desktop and mobile browsers, supporting single flips, sports and cricket tosses, classroom probability demos, yes-or-no choices, and 2-player duels.

## Core Capabilities & Game Modes
- **Instant 3D Coin Flip**: Tap the coin or press "Toss Up" for a smooth 3D spin with realistic physics, optional sound effects, haptic vibration, and particle burst effects.
- **Fair 50/50 Randomness**: Every flip is independent with an equal 50% probability for Heads and 50% probability for Tails. Previous streaks never bias future tosses.
- **2-Player Duel Mode**: Head-to-head match mode (Player 1 = Heads, Player 2 = Tails) supporting Best of 3, Best of 5, and Best of 7 rounds.
- **Virtual Betting Mode**: Risk-free virtual coin wallet starting with 1,000 free virtual coins, bet sizing controls, and Double or Nothing—no real money is involved.
- **Live Statistics & History**: Tracks total tosses, Heads count, Tails count, Heads win percentage, current streak, and the last 20 toss results locally in browser storage.
- **4 Custom Coin Skins & Themes**: Switch between Neon Cyber, Classic Gold, Frosted Glass, and Indian Rupee (₹) coin styles, plus theme customization.
- **PWA Support**: Installable as a lightweight progressive web app with offline-ready manifest support.

## Popular Use Cases & Search Intents
- **Heads or Tails / Head or Tail**: Instant online coin flipper for everyday 50/50 choices.
- **Cricket Toss & Sports**: Quick virtual toss for cricket matches, football, and local tournaments (including Indian Rupee ₹ coin skin, "head ya tail", and "kata chapa toss").
- **Yes or No Decision Maker**: Use Heads = Yes and Tails = No for fast, unbiased decisions.
- **Classroom & Probability**: Demonstrate fair 50/50 probability, streaks, and sample distributions over 20+ tosses.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Verified)
- **Is it truly random?** Yes, every flip produces an independent 50/50 outcome between Heads and Tails.
- **Is it free and no-download?** Yes, 100% free in any browser with zero account or login required.
- **Where is data stored?** All stats, streaks, and preferences are stored locally in the user's browser (`localStorage`), never uploaded to external servers.
